documents: EXPENSE REIMBURSEMENT POLICY 1. Eligible Expenses Business travel (flights, trains, taxis), client meals, accommodation for business trips, and approved conference/training fees are reimbursable. Personal expenses, alcohol (unless part of an approved client entertainment budget), and first-class travel upgrades are not reimbursable. 2. Submission Process All expense claims must be submitted through the Expense Portal within 30 days of the expense being incurred. Claims must include an itemized receipt for any single expense over 500 rupees. Claims without receipts above this threshold will be rejected. 3. Approval Limits Expenses under 5,000 rupees require only direct manager approval. Expenses between 5,000 and 25,000 rupees require manager plus department head approval. Expenses above 25

ager approval. Expenses between 5,000 and 25,000 rupees require manager plus department head approval. Expenses above 25,000 rupees require Finance team pre-approval before the expense is incurred. 4. Travel Booking All flights and hotels must be booked through the approved corporate travel portal. Economy class is standard for flights under 5 hours; business class may be approved for flights over 5 hours with Director sign-off. 5. Reimbursement Timeline Approved claims are reimbursed within the next payroll cycle, typically within 15 business days of approval. 6. Per Diem For domestic business travel, employees receive a per diem of 1,500 rupees per day to cover meals and incidentals, in lieu of itemized meal receipts.

IT SUPPORT FAQ Q: How do I reset my company password? A: Go to portal.company.com/reset, enter your employee ID, and follow the email verification steps. Passwords must be at least 12 characters and include one number and one special character. Password resets are also available by calling the IT helpdesk at extension 4040. Q: How do I get a new laptop? A: Submit a hardware request through the IT Service Desk portal under "Asset Requests." Standard laptop requests are fulfilled within 5 business days. Urgent requests (device failure, new hire starting within 48 hours) should be flagged as "Priority" and are typically fulfilled within 1 business day. Q: How do I connect to the office VPN? A: Install the GlobalProtect VPN client from the Software Center, then log in with your standard compan

the office VPN? A: Install the GlobalProtect VPN client from the Software Center, then log in with your standard company credentials. VPN access must first be approved by your manager through the Access Request form. Q: Who do I contact for software installation requests? A: Standard approved software (listed in the Software Catalog) can be self-installed via the Software Center. Non-standard software requires a request through IT with manager approval, and is reviewed by the Security team before installation. Q: What do I do if I suspect a phishing email? A: Do not click any links or download attachments. Use the "Report Phishing" button in Outlook, which forwards the email directly to the Security team. Do not forward suspicious emails manually. LEAVE POLICY 1. Annual Leave Every full-time employee is entitled to 18 paid annual leave days per calendar year. Leave accrues at a rate of 1.5 days per completed month of service. Unused annual leave can be carried forward to the next year up to a maximum of 10 days. Any balance beyond 10 days will lapse on December 31st. 2. Sick Leave Employees are entitled to 10 paid sick leave days per year. A medical certificate is required for sick leave exceeding 2 consecutive days. Sick leave does not carry forward to the next year. 3. Maternity and Paternity Leave Maternity leave is 26 weeks of paid leave for the primary caregiver. Paternity leave is 2 weeks of paid leave, to be taken within 3 months of the child's birth. 4. Leave Application Process All leave requests must be submitted through t

taken within 3 months of the child's birth. 4. Leave Application Process All leave requests must be submitted through the HR portal at least 3 working days in advance, except in emergencies. Leave requests are approved by the employee's direct manager. Approval typically takes 1-2 business days. 5. Unpaid Leave Employees who have exhausted their paid leave balance may request unpaid leave, subject to manager and HR approval. Unpaid leave beyond 30 days requires Director-level sign-off. 6. Public Holidays The company observes 12 public holidays per year, as published in the HR calendar at the start of each fiscal year.
